basic_information.article_id: unique identifiert for this article (NOT the reference number)
basic_information.price_negotiable: if you want to accept price suggestions
basic_information.on_hold: option to mark the watch as reserved
basic_information.availability: in stock / to be procured / on request
basic_information.product_name: Listing's title. If long, brand and model are extracted as title, the rest is subtitle
basic_information.gender: Is it a Mens watch or a Ladies watch?
basic_information.condition: overall condition of the watch: brand new, unworn, very good (mint), good (fine), fair, scrap (incomplete/defect)
basic_information.serial_number: you can provide a serial number for scam / theft check. Not visible for visitors
basic_information.description: This text will appear in the free-text "Description" field on the website
basic_information.link: link to the watch on the merchant's page

signs_of_wear.wearlevel_dial: hier you can specify the level of wear for specific watch parts
signs_of_wear.wearlevel_glass: slight signs of wear / Barely visible

caliber.movement_type: automatic / manual winding / quartz / solar / smart watch

case.crystal: sapphire glass, mineral glass, plastic, plexiglass, regular glass

functionality.function_defects: list of functions that no longer properly work
functionality.measured_waterproof_atm: tested actual water resistance (during revision or service)
functionality.measured_accuracy: measured accuracy (i.g. in seconds per day)
functionality.measured_amplitude: amplitude of the balance wheel (in degrees)

miscellaneous.modified_parts: list of watch parts that were modified or customized i.e. no longer original
miscellaneous.other_attributes: luminescent hands, small seconds, rotating bezel, limited edition ...
miscellaneous.revision_type: type of revision carried out: in-house or by manufacturer
miscellaneous.revision_date: the date of the last revision

images.image: first image of product, this image will appear as thumbnail on the search results page
room for more images, up to 16 total
the link to an image should be enclosed in "" tags
